Use a compact instrument group in the LEFT-UPPER OUTSIDE gap of the circular planet, and ONE small facility-management entry in the RIGHT-UPPER OUTSIDE gap. These are stable screen controls, independent of building positions. They must NOT follow or overlap moving objects. Keep orbital objects and scout approach/flight corridors clear; put controls outside their visible envelopes, not on the orbit paths.

Surface refinery rests on its lower-front landmass with contact shadow/local tangent, no floating icon. Suggested grounded workshop on left land near limb. Orbiting station separated from terrain; suggested unfinished U-shaped shipyard in fixed near-orbit space; scout follows projected orbit tangent with short wake. Buildings only watching/status, NO labels, buttons, click halos, tracking callouts or leader lines attached to buildings. Tiny amber readiness beacon on refinery is enough. No asteroids.
